rationale: C01 is the strongest plausible template because its title describes the same narrowly framed act: delegating a presidential function to the Director of the Bureau of the Budget. That close correspondence is more specific than the general delegation machinery in C03 or C19, although C01's operative text is unavailable. C03 supplies a closely parallel statutory-delegation formula involving the same official, while C19 also delegates a statute-specific presidential authority to that official but concerns different administrative machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The functions vested in the President by the third proviso of section 5 ... are hereby delegated to the Director of the Bureau of the Budget.

shared_material.explanation: C01's title identifies the same concrete drafting structure: a presidential function delegated to the Director of the Bureau of the Budget.
